# Shared dashboard assets

Chart.js 4.4.6 and Geist / Geist Mono font assets copied from the existing
MultiTool dashboard to keep typography, chart behaviour and theme consistent.
The unmodified shared dashboard stylesheet is `multitool.css`; Screenpipe layout
and overrides live in `../dashboard.css`.

- Chart.js: MIT; see `Chart.js-LICENSE.txt`.
- Geist and Geist Mono: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see the two OFL files.
- Licenses obtained from the upstream Chart.js release and Google Fonts font
  directories. Fonts are served locally; no external font request is made.
